title: u-5: managed-kit-adoption
description:
## Released managed tooling and supported consumer checks
## Deliverables
1. Install actual released sc-lint0.8.5 native/wheel/kit via its supported dry-run/apply flow, preserving approved U2 strict policy, packaged pytests, PATH/cross fixes, logging/artifacts and real exit/envelope semantics. Verify actual artifacts, not assumed future support.
2. Upgrade sc-publish through its supported installer; PR847 is open and QA-passed per lead. Reuse that change, do not recreate it or hand-edit vendored kit files. Retain prerelease/archive supported flows and offline CLI payload support.
3. Declare existing consumer preflight_checks id/description/run entries for scripts/check_render_regressions.py and scripts/check_install_matrix.py. The first reuses U2 current-only byte command. The second verifies successful workflow_dispatch integration evidence for the candidate/artifact identities using ordinary run metadata; missing/stale/failed evidence fails. No new shared evidence schema/service or kit-specific consumer logic. U8 supplies real matrix evidence; U9 proves integrated positive/negative behavior.
4. Enable sc-docli through the kit's existing docli config; every publish runs it and stale generated CLI docs block preflight. External executable only, no sc-docli crate dependency. U6 supplies actual Clap model/generated content; U9 verifies installed offline delivery.
5. Preserve actual policy and exit/report behavior. Kit/config/helper tests prove pass/finding/config/large-finding normalization without dropping stderr or confusing analyzer exit10 with success. No publication in this sprint.
Matrix verifier contract: before publication, scripts/check_install_matrix.py computes SHA-256 from every exact release artifact selected by the existing release/build manifest and compares its artifact identity and digest to the successful U8 workflow run. Obtain U8 run metadata and per-artifact digests from that run’s existing workflow artifact outputs; resolve the expected workflow/repository/candidate and successful run through ordinary GitHub run metadata, not consumer-supplied success flags. Reject missing, extra/uncovered, stale, failed, wrong-candidate or mismatched artifact identities/digests, including changed bytes from the same candidate. No shared kit schema is introduced.
Release sequencing owner (CONSISTENCY-001): U5 verifies the canonical sc-publish capability, routes any missing capability to the sc-publish owner, and adopts it through the supported immutable upstream package, not patch vendored workflows. PR847 reuse alone is insufficient unless it provides this behavior. The consumer release workflow selects the successful U8 workflow run for the exact candidate and intended release version, downloads its already-built release files, and runs existing preflight_checks on those files before gate-and-tag. gate-and-tag must preserve that candidate/tree and artifact versions. Publisher jobs then consume those same retained files, rechecking SHA-256 immediately before upload; remove the current post-gate rebuild path for these artifacts. No rebuild, version rewrite, fallback build, or substitution may inherit old matrix evidence. Changed candidate/version/bytes requires a new build and matrix run. U5 implements this supported input/staging path and deterministic negative tests using fixtures; U8 provides real files and U9 owns actual producer-to-publisher rehearsal. A missing upstream capability is an owned U5 deliverable/blocker, never assumed present or a local fork.
Missing upstream release capability remains a U5 adoption blocker: coordinate the change with its canonical owner and verify the released supported installer; consumer U5 never claims ownership of an upstream fork or patches copied assets.
design:
Agent level: frontier. Thin external protocol plus one CLI consumer/managed root tooling form a justified vertical integration slice; no rule implementation enters sc-compose. Preserve ADR0016/0017 ownership and fixed executable security; accept pin-contract doc amendments before development. The seven-step package skill is authoritative, with lead's explicit pin-first/removal and read-only sanity ruling retained.0.8.4 wheel tests/whole-managed-config drift are confirmed defects, so do not drop pytests, hand-provision or edit managed TOML to pass early.0.8.5 helper policies/log roots/PATH behavior must be verified in released artifacts, not inferred from planned upstream work. This sprint owns managed Justfile/root-lint/ci.yml wiring; independent docs/ABI/wheel sprints do not edit these paths. U.9 adds their integration calls after this installed kit contract is accepted. The sc-publish upgrade is supported installation/configuration only, not a fork: all managed files are copied/rendered from the selected kit and converge under repeat dry-run. Its [prerelease] fields and archive capabilities come from that actual version. No new live-tag/channel-qualification requirement is introduced by this plan; publication remains out of scope.
Exact Target: supported kit manifests/configs, existing sc-lint adapter and scripts/check_install_matrix.py; retain one consumer contract per check. U8 follows this sprint for the real release-manifest/build inputs and shared release paths; no cycle. Missing producer evidence is a truthful refusal until U8/U9, not U5 claiming full matrix PASS.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test --workspace, targeted adapter/tooling tests and supported kit dry-run convergence pass. sc-lint actual0.8.5 strict outcomes/true counts, pytests and raw exits are preserved. Kit consumer config uses existing id/description/run and docli interfaces; script negative cases fail for absent/wrong-candidate matrix evidence and unlisted byte differences, stale CLI reference blocks preflight. Full real producer/consumer acceptance is U9 after U8, not a fixture-only U5 closure of matrix delivery. No publishing. Targeted deterministic verifier tests include identical-candidate wrong-SHA-256, missing digest/artifact, uncovered release artifact and matching exact-byte success; digests are computed from the selected files, not trusted filenames. Supported kit installation demonstrably routes release publisher jobs to retained tested files instead of post-gate rebuilds; selection/version/hash failures stop before gate/tag and any last-mile digest mismatch stops before upload. Fixture tests prove the path; actual U8-backed end-to-end closure belongs to U9.

dependencies.title: phase-u: managed lint, complete platform delivery and existing Beads ports — DRAFT
dependencies.description:
## DRAFT goal
Deliver release-ready Phase U changes on integrate/phase-u; publish1.8.0 only AFTER Phase U. Beads is the plan authority. This draft is not dispatch approval.
## Sprint set / agent level
U1 frozen carry-in/rebuild [fast]; U2 policy+early byte check [normal]; U3 ONE existing-refactor verification batch, three crate sections [normal]; U4 cross contract [frontier]; U5 released lint/publish kits+consumer preflight config [frontier]; U6 external sc-docli reference [normal]; U7 all-three ABI3 bindings [frontier]; U8 complete platform/integration install matrix [normal]; U9 upgrade acceptance [frontier]; U10 port/verify compatible Beads [normal]; U11 port/verify existing advanced pour [frontier]; U12 extend/reuse compatibility check [normal]; U13 closing regression/fuzz+whole-phase review [frontier]. Numbering is contiguous; branch/layer numbers never serialize independent work.
## Current decisions
D1 APPROVED: [line_counts] max_production_lines=1000, no exclusions.
D2 APPROVED: exact identity policy and canonical env owners from the reviewed proposal; ONE canonical non-Rust JSON fixture supplies policy/test token data, including ATM_HOME; repo_boundaries.rs removes concat! and loads the fixture. Forbidden literals remain randlee/team-lead/arch-comp/arch-ccomp/comp/comps/team-lead@example.invalid/ATM_HOME; canonical owners remain template_store.rs for SC_COMPOSE_DATA_DIR/SC_COMPOSE_TEMPLATE_DIR and commands/template_lint.rs for SC_COMPOSE_TEMPLATE_CONTRACTS_SCOPE.
D3 APPROVED — FIX #787, owner comp's completed recovery replay, recorded by U.1 (dc134dc2 plus 6311b90a in the selected base): wheel compose(), compose_file() and render_loaded_template() always apply the CLI checked-render contract to JSON outputs selected by extension/format, raising ScRenderError ERR_RENDER_JSON_MALFORMED. Replay source 588ab3d7 / prior replay 49e4dd59, with a caller-visible CHANGELOG Fixed entry naming #787. Drop a50d4d9f/e8143961 opt-in variants. Preserve non-JSON bytes and schema-less MiniJinja rendering semantics; D7 names the approved malformed-JSON checked-output exception and the accepted validation false-positive removals; unrelated legacy behavior is not exempted.
D4 SUPERSEDING RULING: CPython>=3.11, abi3-py311, for ALL THREE distributions;3.12+ uses the same stable-ABI wheel.<=3.10 is excluded by choice. macOS CLT /usr/bin/python3 at3.9 needs a newer interpreter. D5 all-three package scope retained.
D6 CURRENT BASE: origin/integrate/phase-u, now on develop9a39bc1b. No develop replacement/reset/recovery lease step. Preserve MiniJinja =2.18.0 and accepted recovery deltas; U1 rebuilds the frozen #825/#831 stack on this base.
D7 APPROVED: v1.7.0 Rust/Python/CLI/overlaid-suite/schema-less compatibility verification in U.12 with final U.13 acceptance, with the #787 JSON bug-fix exception in D3 and this accepted exception: D7 permits only the diagnostic false-positive removals already in selected-base commits 9402a2bb/0a1052d8/2a06513a (True/False/None literals, filter/call targets, Jinja test/block-tag names and comment/raw bodies cease erroneous ERR_VAL_UNDECLARED_TOKEN); render bytes remain identical where both versions succeed, no real variable may be missed and no new rejection may be introduced. The user condition is MET by independent QM PASS 01M6HZR22HZXX4HDW1CMFHHA86: 229 unique *.j2 (atm-core150 + sc-compose79;178 content duplicates removed), v1.7.0 f4fda4b9 vs 3997e3566a5ff1ee6d97c5fc16c4e840ffd850db, across validate, validate --strict, render, render+vars and render --strict --check-render. The only new acceptance was14 previously false-rejected plan-hardening/orchestration XML templates; unchanged exit comparison excludes those explicitly approved rejection-to-acceptance cases. This does not exempt arbitrary CLI/JSON diagnostic changes or future regressions.

## Delivery coverage
Required6platforms(macOS/Windows/Linux x x64/arm64) x5artifacts(Rust CLI, sc-compose/sc-sha/sc-composer-beads wheels, sc-sha-go)=30 artifact/platform cells, through applicable existing channels. Rust:GitHub/Homebrew/winget/Scoop; wheels:PyPI with TestPyPI rehearsal; Go:target ZIP modules/GitHub assets. Preserve crates.io source-package delivery; do not invent a Go package registry. Current missing cells are obligations, not optional triage.
Full install matrix is ONLY the workflow_dispatch integration test and MUST be verified by consumer preflight before publish. Tested Python minors3.11/3.12/3.13/3.14 retain the previous declared ceiling, not an upper product bound;6platforms x4minors=24 interpreter/platform cells, all3wheels, pip+uv. Current-only golden byte checks run in every normal sprint CI and locally. Sprint CI never runs the full integration matrix.
## Existing Beads implementation
Port and verify the existing recovered code/tests/fuzz; do not rebuild from scratch or blindly import strict-only ancestry. sc-compose constructs structure/values, bd validates/creates; advanced mode avoids bd interpolation defects. Preserve legacy Rust/Python/CLI compatibility and public struct literals. Existing tests pin safe transport, include defaults, filters, explicit native ownership, invalid-graph/path handling and diagnostics. Use real orchestration sprint/finding formulas as fixtures. User confirmations, source/test pins and accepted narrow API adaptations are recorded in planning, not silently chosen during a port.
## Issue ownership
#648 U6/U9; #817 U1/U9; #820 U7/U8/U9; #819 superseded by820; #618 U11/U12/U13; #785 retained stripping verified U10; #791 explicit validation U10, never a strict-only default. All remain open until actual acceptance; no publication in this phase.

## Planning-owned dispatch preconditions (single gate definition)
Before dispatching U10 or U11, the lead records the approved FR-24 revision and accepted ADR-0024 revision, plus a disposition/evidence for each ADR-0024 Open decision1 selector/source-compatible API,2 input collisions,3 registry routing/flat literal-safe boundary,4 include/default/missing-value semantics,5 explicit schema-validation surface,6 literal-safe evaluation strategy,7 broader pinned-bd semantics. Separately record the supported bd release artifact/version/checksum/platform scope; development probe407fe27 is not an implicit production pin. Unresolved entries block those port sprints, including U10 explicit validate --brace-count under decision5. These are planning-owned choices, not choices delegated to port developers. ADR-0024 decision8 gates only the U13 complete historical-coverage claim, not unrelated implementation. Plan-QA PASS alone does not resolve these decisions. Current state: these entries remain pending; no values are fabricated by this plan correction.
dependencies.design:
## Boundary map
CLI owns orchestration/external-tool invocation and error normalization; sc-composer stays pure; Beads library owns host-neutral rendering/argv/graph receipts; bindings are thin adapters. No ATM runtime dependency. CLI->composer/beads, beads->composer, composer->sc-sha; adapters->owned libraries. U1 preserves the approved dependency/advisory/inventory fixes and strict MiniJinja pin.
## Landing rules — sole owner
L1. All Phase U code is based on integrate/phase-u. U1 rebuilds/lands the frozen #831 then17 #825 rows early, preserving source/QA mappings, approved adaptations and drop dispositions. No planner reset or develop replacement.
L2. One authorized stack writer composes append-only layers. Developers use isolated worktrees/disjoint fences; planned PR targets are lower bounds, not a serial schedule. No direct sprint PR to develop.
L3. After final exact-candidate acceptance and ONE all-change phase-ending review in U13, the authorized lead/writer performs the ordinary reviewed phase landing from integrate/phase-u to develop. This planning task does not land code. Publication1.8.0 follows Phase U.
## Parallel ownership
After U1, U2/U3/U6/U7 run concurrently. U3 is readonly on the carried candidate. U2->U4->U5 is the policy/kit track; U7 supplies ABI code. U8 depends on U7 AND U5 because it executes the actual kit/build-manifest contract and owns overlapping release configuration after the kit install; this is a real producer/file dependency, not a docs-to-ABI edge. U9 consumes U3/U6/U8 (U5 is already an ancestor), then the user-directed U10->U11->U12->U13 Beads chain. No U6->U7 edge. U2's byte-check CI step precedes U5/U9 edits to ci.yml. U12/U13 extend the same harness, never create a competing baseline framework.
## Evidence lifetime — sole owner
E1. U1 has the one frozen18-row source/QA table. Stop maintaining it after carry-in acceptance except changed-head dispositions; retain ordinary phase history. The old import payload is historical, not a second plan; live Beads is authoritative. Only index/config/DAG are committed orchestration metadata.
E2. Keep ordinary command stdout/stderr, exits, candidate identities, run links and real artifact hashes. Full-matrix workflow evidence must remain accessible through the publication preflight that consumes it (which is after phase closure); expired/missing evidence is not PASS, retain via existing CI controls or rerun that actual candidate. Reuse exact-head evidence; affected changes/failures justify reruns. After the final consumer accepts it, stop maintaining summaries and let ordinary scratch/artifact retention expire. No new evidence service/certificate/schema/database. Persistent regressions and shipped docs remain product assets.
E3. Every real-bd exercise uses one isolated throwaway instance at a time, never shared3308; lead coordinates exclusive use. Remove owned probe services, install environments, baseline overlays and temporary worktrees after needed results/inputs are retained, success or failure. Private rehearsal uploads nowhere. Actual repository plan writes use only this repo's configured tracker.
## Contracts and decisions
Managed sc-lint0.8.5 is verified from the released native/wheel/kit: exit10 retains ok:true/data.findings, helper5 retains ok:false/error.details.findings (capped10 plus true findings_count); config3/usage2; never turn findings into strict green. Preserve pytests, logging/artifacts, interpreter PATH and cross rows. sc-publish upgrade includes PR847 and consumes supported preflight_checks id/description/run plus kit docli config, no hand-patched vendored kit or consumer-specific kit feature. sc-docli is an external tool, never a crate dependency.
The approved defaults/compatibility rules govern ports. ADR/requirements decisions and amendments are planning-owned on the reviewed docs branch based on c089c8a3, never imported from the old strict-only plan ancestry. Existing-code/test evidence resolves meaning where it already exists; genuine remaining choices are named by the lead, not an excuse to rebuild. No new anchor locking is implied by pouring this draft.

Corrective ownership: when U3/U12/U13 finds a defect, the lead/sole integration writer assigns the reviewed append-only corrective layer to the existing implementation owner and amends its explicit file fence before edits; verification sprints do not acquire arbitrary write scope. Cargo.lock has one writer: U7 after carry-in; U6 uses existing dependencies and does not regenerate it; U9 integration writer resolves combined manifest/lock consistency before acceptance. E2 requires a new qualifying publication-time full matrix for the final candidate after U10-U13 changes; U8 upgrade-time evidence is not reusable for changed shipped code.
dependencies.acceptance_criteria:
1. Required exact-candidate macOS setup/lint/test, cargo test --workspace, all-scope Windows xwin compile/clippy and required Linux/Windows/ARM64 CI pass with strict rules; no skipped pytests, weakened assertions or flaky tests.
2. All30 artifact/platform cells and all-three abi3-py311 metadata/installs are accounted for. Workflow-dispatch integration matrix is required by publish preflight; normal sprint CI runs the small byte check/cached install path, never the full matrix.
3. U2's one current-only Python byte regression command uses committed v1.7.0 goldens and issue-linked approved bug exceptions; U5 exposes the same command through consumer preflight_checks; U12 extends/reuses it. Missing cases/goldens and failed render commands cannot pass as empty output.
4. Existing Beads ports preserve supported APIs/default bytes except approved real bug fixes. Real sprint/finding orchestration formulas, actual created-value readback and closing historical fuzz regressions pass. Missing171-10 requires recovery or explicitly approved equivalent before complete coverage is claimed.
5. U13 aggregates the final entire change set and single phase-ending review; root landing/evidence rules apply once. Nothing is published or merged by this draft planning operation. No dispatch until the plan-review bead is closed PASS.
